entries.label: HELLO_SAMATRA
entries.body:
You may not approach the ancient Sa-Matra, the symbol of Ur-Quan dominance!
Your presence here is further violation of the slave laws
which your species have already violated so flagrantly.
We cannot tolerate such insubordination!
Your species' penalty shall be annihilation!
entries.source:
You may not approach the ancient Sa-Matra, the symbol of Ur-Quan dominance!
Your presence here is further violation of the slave laws
which your species have already violated so flagrantly.
We cannot tolerate such insubordination!
Your species' penalty shall be annihilation!
entries.translation:
不得接近古老的薩馬特拉， 烏爾關霸權的象徵！
你出現在此，又一次違反奴 隸法
而你的物種早已公然屢次觸 犯。
我們無法容忍這種抗命！
你們物種的刑罰將是滅絕！

entries.label: SENSE_EVIL
entries.body:
There is something wrong here... something which makes my sheath retract and my talons ooze.
I sense the ugliness of a thousand evil thoughts
and I have located the source of these fetid emanations.
They come from aboard your vessel!
Foolish renegade human, why have you come here? All that you have found
is your inevitable punishment.
entries.source:
There is something wrong here... something which makes my sheath retract and my talons ooze.
I sense the ugliness of a thousand evil thoughts
and I have located the source of these fetid emanations.
They come from aboard your vessel!
Foolish renegade human, why have you come here? All that you have found
is your inevitable punishment.
entries.translation:
這裡有什麼不對勁…… 某種東西令我的鞘膜收縮、 利爪滲液。
我感受到一千個邪惡念頭的 醜陋
而且已經定位這些腐臭意念 的來源。
它們來自你的船上！
愚蠢的人類叛徒， 你為何來此？你所找到的
只有無可避免的懲罰。

entries.label: INIT_URQUAN_WAKE_UP
entries.body:
...in addition, your refusal to answer our transmissions is taken as an insult
which shall earn you the reward of Death unless you respond immediately!
entries.source:
...in addition, your refusal to answer our transmissions is taken as an insult
which shall earn you the reward of Death unless you respond immediately!
entries.translation:
……此外，你拒絕回應我方 通訊，已被視為侮辱
除非立刻回答， 否則你贏得的獎賞就只有死 亡！

entries.label: where_am_i
entries.body: Hey!? Where am I?
entries.source: Hey!? Where am I?
entries.translation: 嘿！？我在哪裡？

entries.label: YOU_ARE_HERE
entries.body:
Your insubordination is intolerable!
You MUST obey the slave laws, or face our gruesome punishment!
entries.source:
Your insubordination is intolerable!
You MUST obey the slave laws, or face our gruesome punishment!
entries.translation:
你的抗命令人無法容忍！
你必須服從奴隸法， 否則就面對我們駭人的刑 罰！

entries.label: why_does_my_head_hurt
entries.body: Why does my head hurt?
entries.source: Why does my head hurt?
entries.translation: 我的頭為什麼這麼痛？

entries.label: HURTS_BECAUSE
entries.body:
You forget that the consequences of your misbehavior
will cause great suffering for your entire people.
entries.source:
You forget that the consequences of your misbehavior
will cause great suffering for your entire people.
entries.translation:
你忘了，自己行為不端所帶 來的後果
將使你所有族人承受巨大苦 難。

entries.label: what_about_2_weeks
entries.body: Wow!? Where did the last two weeks go?
entries.source: Wow!? Where did the last two weeks go?
entries.translation: 哇！？過去兩個星期跑哪去 了？

entries.label: ABOUT_2_WEEKS
entries.body:
We have been lenient with your species, because you are so immature.
Now this attitude has changed.
You WILL be held responsible for your malfeasance!
entries.source:
We have been lenient with your species, because you are so immature.
Now this attitude has changed.
You WILL be held responsible for your malfeasance!
entries.translation:
我們一直寬待你的物種， 因為你們如此不成熟。
如今這種態度已經改變。
你必須為自己的惡行負責！

entries.label: compulsion
entries.body: Whoa! I must have been under some form of weird mental compulsion.
entries.source: Whoa! I must have been under some form of weird mental compulsion.
entries.translation: 哇！我剛才一定受到某種詭 異的精神強迫。

entries.label: WHAT_COMPULSION
entries.body:
WHAT DID YOU SAY?!
COMPULSION!?
WHAT HAPPENED?! EXPLAIN!
entries.source:
WHAT DID YOU SAY?!
COMPULSION!?
WHAT HAPPENED?! EXPLAIN!
entries.translation:
你說什麼？！
強迫！？
發生了什麼？！解釋！

entries.label: wascally_little_guy
entries.body: It was this wascally little guy in Umgah space. He did it!
entries.source: It was this wascally little guy in Umgah space. He did it!
entries.translation: 是烏姆加空域那個淘氣的小 傢伙。是他做的！

entries.label: WHAT_IT_LOOK_LIKE
entries.body: WHAT DID THE CREATURE LOOK LIKE?!
entries.source: WHAT DID THE CREATURE LOOK LIKE?!
entries.translation: 那個生物長什麼樣子？！

entries.label: terran_amphibian
entries.body: It resembled a large, terran amphibian.
entries.source: It resembled a large, terran amphibian.
entries.translation: 牠很像一隻巨大的地球兩棲 類。

entries.label: talking_pet_on_steroids
entries.body: It looked like one of your Talking Pets on brain steroids.
entries.source: It looked like one of your Talking Pets on brain steroids.
entries.translation: 看起來像你們的會說話的寵 物，腦子吃了類固醇。

entries.label: BAD_NEWS
entries.body:
A Talking Pet with compulsion powers!
This is grave news indeed, the worst in millenia!
We will speed the war against our cousins, the Kohr-Ah
then we shall deal with this neo-Dnyarri, this Talking Pet.
Alien Captain! You have done a service for us greater than you can possibly imagine.
Your reward is continued survival, and if you return to Earth and destroy your vessel IMMEDIATELY
we will abolish all punishment against you and your species.
Now leave!... and never return.
entries.source:
A Talking Pet with compulsion powers!
This is grave news indeed, the worst in millenia!
We will speed the war against our cousins, the Kohr-Ah
then we shall deal with this neo-Dnyarri, this Talking Pet.
Alien Captain! You have done a service for us greater than you can possibly imagine.
Your reward is continued survival, and if you return to Earth and destroy your vessel IMMEDIATELY
we will abolish all punishment against you and your species.
Now leave!... and never return.
entries.translation:
擁有強迫能力的會說話的寵 物！
這的確是極其嚴重的消息， 是數千年來最糟的消息！
我們會加速對手足克爾阿的 戰爭
然後處理這個新迪納里， 這隻會說話的寵物。
外星船長！你替我們立下的 功勞，遠超乎你所能想像。
你的獎賞是繼續活命； 如果立刻返回地球並摧毀自 己的船艦
我們將撤銷對你與你族人的 一切懲罰。
現在離開！…… 永遠不要回來。

entries.label: turd_and_toad
entries.body: Kind of like a cross between a turd and a toad.
entries.source: Kind of like a cross between a turd and a toad.
entries.translation: 大概像一坨糞便和一隻蟾蜍 的混種。

entries.label: WHAT_IS_TURD_AND_TOAD
entries.body: These references are obscure. Respecify.
entries.source: These references are obscure. Respecify.
entries.translation: 這些指涉晦澀不明。 重新描述。

entries.label: alien_mind_control
entries.body: I think I was attacked by some form of alien mind control!
entries.source: I think I was attacked by some form of alien mind control!
entries.translation: 我想我遭到某種外星心智控 制攻擊！

entries.label: WHAT_FELT_LIKE
entries.body:
WHAT?!! OH NO!!!
IT CANNOT BE!
QUICK HUMAN! TELL ME: WHAT DID IT FEEL LIKE, THIS COMPULSION?
entries.source:
WHAT?!! OH NO!!!
IT CANNOT BE!
QUICK HUMAN! TELL ME: WHAT DID IT FEEL LIKE, THIS COMPULSION?
entries.translation:
什麼？！！喔，不！！！
不可能！
快，人類！告訴我： 那種強迫是什麼感覺？

entries.label: possessed_by_devil
entries.body: I am fairly sure that I was possessed by the devil.
entries.source: I am fairly sure that I was possessed by the devil.
entries.translation: 我相當確定自己被惡魔附身 了。

entries.label: STUPID_DEVIL
entries.body:
Devil? The only real devils are the ones flying the dark ships, human
the murderous Kohr-Ah.
NOW GIVE ME THE INFORMATION I DEMAND!
entries.source:
Devil? The only real devils are the ones flying the dark ships, human
the murderous Kohr-Ah.
NOW GIVE ME THE INFORMATION I DEMAND!
entries.translation:
惡魔？唯一真正的惡魔， 是駕駛黑色船艦的那些傢 伙，人類
也就是嗜殺的克爾阿。
現在把我要求的情報交出 來！

entries.label: falling_asleep
entries.body: It was like I fell asleep, or was unconscious.
entries.source: It was like I fell asleep, or was unconscious.
entries.translation: 感覺就像我睡著了， 或是失去意識。

entries.label: someone_else_controlled
entries.body: I felt like someone had control of my mind and my body.
entries.source: I felt like someone had control of my mind and my body.
entries.translation: 我覺得有人控制了我的心智 與身體。

entries.label: SOUNDS_FAMILIAR
entries.body:
This sounds all too familiar... yes, the nightmare begins again.
Perhaps we should contact the Kohr-Ah Primat, explain to her.
No, they will not believe. They are too stubborn and simple-minded.
They will not see the danger until it is too late!
Human, begone! Leave my sight! We must defeat the Kohr-Ah speedily
so that we can attend to this new Dnyarri menace.
entries.source:
This sounds all too familiar... yes, the nightmare begins again.
Perhaps we should contact the Kohr-Ah Primat, explain to her.
No, they will not believe. They are too stubborn and simple-minded.
They will not see the danger until it is too late!
Human, begone! Leave my sight! We must defeat the Kohr-Ah speedily
so that we can attend to this new Dnyarri menace.
entries.translation:
這聽起來實在太熟悉…… 沒錯，惡夢再次開始了。
也許我們該聯絡克爾阿首 席，向她說明。
不，他們不會相信。 他們太過頑固， 思想也太簡單。
等到他們看清危險， 一切都已太遲！
人類，滾開！從我眼前消 失！我們必須迅速擊敗克爾 阿
才能處理這個新的迪納里威 脅。

entries.label: before_coffee
entries.body: Kind of like the screen went dark, and then POW! here you were.
entries.source: Kind of like the screen went dark, and then POW! here you were.
entries.translation: 感覺有點像畫面先變黑， 然後砰！你就在這裡了。

entries.label: EXPLAIN
entries.body: WHAT DO YOU MEAN?! ELUCIDATE!
entries.source: WHAT DO YOU MEAN?! ELUCIDATE!
entries.translation: 你是什麼意思？！說清楚！

entries.label: why_explain
entries.body: Why should I explain this to you? You're just going to try to kill me!
entries.source: Why should I explain this to you? You're just going to try to kill me!
entries.translation: 我為什麼要向你解釋？ 你反正只會試著殺我！

entries.label: MUST_EXPLAIN
entries.body:
Human. We Ur-Quan never lie. NEVER!
It is a weakness to lie, and as you haven't noticed, the Ur-Quan are not weak!
So listen, and believe these words
if what you say is true, you were in contact with a creature so horrible, so evil
that it makes ANYTHING else you have ever known TRIVIAL by comparison.
There is no equal to the Dnyarri's cruelty, to its love for torment.
Dying a THOUSAND TIMES would be preferable to what is in store for you
if we do not stop that creature.
So tell me what I want to know, human. NOW!
entries.source:
Human. We Ur-Quan never lie. NEVER!
It is a weakness to lie, and as you haven't noticed, the Ur-Quan are not weak!
So listen, and believe these words
if what you say is true, you were in contact with a creature so horrible, so evil
that it makes ANYTHING else you have ever known TRIVIAL by comparison.
There is no equal to the Dnyarri's cruelty, to its love for torment.
Dying a THOUSAND TIMES would be preferable to what is in store for you
if we do not stop that creature.
So tell me what I want to know, human. NOW!
entries.translation:
人類。我們烏爾關從不說 謊。永遠不會！
說謊是一種軟弱， 而你還沒注意到嗎， 烏爾關並不軟弱！
所以聽好，並相信這些話
如果你所言屬實， 你接觸的生物既恐怖又邪惡
相比之下，你過去所知的一 切事物都微不足道。
沒有任何存在能比得上迪納 里的殘酷，以及牠對折磨的 熱愛。
如果我們無法阻止那個生 物，那麼死上一千次
都比等著你的命運更好。
所以，人類，把我要知道的 事說出來。立刻！

entries.label: bye_init_hypno
entries.body: Look, ah... this was all a mistake. A weird mistake. Bye!
entries.source: Look, ah... this was all a mistake. A weird mistake. Bye!
entries.translation: 聽著，呃……這全是一場誤 會。一場詭異的誤會。 再見！

entries.label: GOODBYE_AND_DIE_INIT_HYPNO
entries.body:
Your insolence knows no bounds!
You will be punished.
entries.source:
Your insolence knows no bounds!
You will be punished.
entries.translation:
你的傲慢毫無止境！
你將受到懲罰。

entries.label: SUBSEQUENT_URQUAN_WAKE_UP
entries.body:
...and again you have violated our great battlefield
interfered with our Doctrinal War!
We were tolerant last time, and permitted you to escape.
This time, you shall not be so fortunate.
entries.source:
...and again you have violated our great battlefield
interfered with our Doctrinal War!
We were tolerant last time, and permitted you to escape.
This time, you shall not be so fortunate.
entries.translation:
……你又一次侵犯我們偉大 的戰場
干預我們的教義戰爭！
上次我們從寬處置， 允許你逃脫。
這一次，你不會再如此幸 運。

entries.label: uh_oh
entries.body: Uh oh.
entries.source: Uh oh.
entries.translation: 糟糕。

entries.label: NO_UH_OH
entries.body:
It is as though your species' brain is too small to hold a simple thought
such as, WE WILL KILL YOU FOR DISOBEYING!
This is not a complex idea.
entries.source:
It is as though your species' brain is too small to hold a simple thought
such as, WE WILL KILL YOU FOR DISOBEYING!
This is not a complex idea.
entries.translation:
看來你們物種的腦容量太 小，連簡單的念頭都裝不下
例如：不服從， 我們就殺了你！
這個概念並不複雜。

entries.label: stop_meeting
entries.body: We have just GOT to stop meeting like this!
entries.source: We have just GOT to stop meeting like this!
entries.translation: 我們真的、真的不能再像這 樣碰面了！

entries.label: NO_STOP_MEETING
entries.body:
You boldly enter our space! Approach this Dreadnought as though it were a recreation base
and then play the dumb hominid?
Who do you take us for, Captain... Spathi!?
entries.source:
You boldly enter our space! Approach this Dreadnought as though it were a recreation base
and then play the dumb hominid?
Who do you take us for, Captain... Spathi!?
entries.translation:
你大膽闖入我方空域！ 接近這艘無畏艦時， 彷彿它是一座休閒基地
然後又裝成愚蠢的人猿？
你把我們當成什麼了， 船長……斯帕西嗎！？

entries.label: bye_sub_hypno
entries.body: Look, ah... big mistake! We're in a hurry! Goodbye.
entries.source: Look, ah... big mistake! We're in a hurry! Goodbye.
entries.translation: 聽著，呃……天大的誤會！ 我們趕時間！再見。

entries.label: GOODBYE_AND_DIE_SUB_HYPNO
entries.body:
We cannot permit such disobedience from our slaves.
You will make an example for the rest of our subordinates.
entries.source:
We cannot permit such disobedience from our slaves.
You will make an example for the rest of our subordinates.
entries.translation:
我們不能容許奴隸如此抗 命。
你將成為其他部屬的前車之 鑑。

entries.label: CAUGHT_YA
entries.body:
SO! THE OFFSPRING HAS RETURNED TO ITS NEST!
When you left this system, our ship was near enough to detect your translation into HyperSpace.
Though we lost your HyperSpace spoor, we were able to backtrack your path here to this star system.
And what did we FIND? An outlaw culture! Humans outside of a slave shield!
You will note that this oversight has been rectified.
Now, we shall finish the job.
entries.source:
SO! THE OFFSPRING HAS RETURNED TO ITS NEST!
When you left this system, our ship was near enough to detect your translation into HyperSpace.
Though we lost your HyperSpace spoor, we were able to backtrack your path here to this star system.
And what did we FIND? An outlaw culture! Humans outside of a slave shield!
You will note that this oversight has been rectified.
Now, we shall finish the job.
entries.translation:
所以！幼雛返回巢穴了！
你離開這個星系時， 我方船艦距離夠近， 足以偵測你躍入超空間。
雖然失去了你的超空間蹤 跡，我們仍成功反向追查航 線來到這個星系。
然後我們發現了什麼？ 非法文化！奴役護盾外的人 類！
你會注意到，這項疏漏已經 獲得糾正。
現在，我們要完成工作。

entries.label: INIT_FLEE_HUMAN
entries.body:
So... it is the human slave.
How strange. I would have thought your species was extinct by now.
We have a suggestion for you.
FLEE! Run as fast and as far as your ship will take you.
entries.source:
So... it is the human slave.
How strange. I would have thought your species was extinct by now.
We have a suggestion for you.
FLEE! Run as fast and as far as your ship will take you.
entries.translation:
所以……是那個人類奴隸。
真奇怪。我還以為你的物種 現在應該已經滅絕。
我們有一項建議。
逃！盡你船艦所能， 逃得越快、越遠越好。

entries.label: SUBSEQUENT_FLEE_HUMAN
entries.body:
Human? You are a fool! Why are you still here?
Flee!... before the Kohr-Ah find you!
entries.source:
Human? You are a fool! Why are you still here?
Flee!... before the Kohr-Ah find you!
entries.translation:
人類？你這蠢貨！ 為什麼還留在這裡？
快逃！……趁克爾阿還沒找 到你！

entries.label: why_flee
entries.body: Why should we run away?
entries.source: Why should we run away?
entries.translation: 我們為什麼該逃走？

entries.label: FLEE_BECAUSE
entries.body:
Because you are doomed if you remain here!
Our Doctrinal War is over. We, the Kzer-Za, have lost.
RUN HUMAN!
Because if you do not run -- do not find somewhere to hide and nurture your species
you are extinct, and we, who have tried to protect you
are now powerless to stop the killing frenzy of the Kohr-Ah.
entries.source:
Because you are doomed if you remain here!
Our Doctrinal War is over. We, the Kzer-Za, have lost.
RUN HUMAN!
Because if you do not run -- do not find somewhere to hide and nurture your species
you are extinct, and we, who have tried to protect you
are now powerless to stop the killing frenzy of the Kohr-Ah.
entries.translation:
因為繼續留在這裡， 你必死無疑！
我們的教義戰爭已經結束。 我們克澤爾扎敗了。
快逃，人類！
如果你不逃——不找個地方 躲藏並延續自己的物種
你們就會滅絕； 而我們曾試圖保護你們
如今卻再也無力阻止克爾阿 的殺戮狂潮。

entries.label: what_happens_now
entries.body: So what happens now?
entries.source: So what happens now?
entries.translation: 那接下來會怎樣？

entries.label: HAPPENS_NOW
entries.body:
Now the Kohr-Ah and their Eternal Doctrine have free reign in these stars.
The Kohr-Ah will visit each of our slave races, staying only long enough
to ensure than not one of the species remains alive.
entries.source:
Now the Kohr-Ah and their Eternal Doctrine have free reign in these stars.
The Kohr-Ah will visit each of our slave races, staying only long enough
to ensure than not one of the species remains alive.
entries.translation:
現在，克爾阿與他們的永恆 教義得以在這片星域任意橫 行。
克爾阿會造訪我們的每個奴 隸種族，只停留足夠長的時 間
以確保該物種沒有任何個體 存活。

entries.label: what_about_you
entries.body: So what happens to you?
entries.source: So what happens to you?
entries.translation: 那你們會怎樣？

entries.label: ABOUT_US
entries.body:
Human, days ago, I would have killed you for your insolence
but now... what is the use? You and your kind will receive the ultimate punishment soon enough.
I will tell you what you wish to know.
While the Kohr-Ah move through space, killing your neighboring species
we shall remain here, guarding the trophy... the Sa-Matra.
When the Kohr-Ah are done with their dark business
they will take possession of the Sa-Matra, and then we will part ways
traversing the galaxy in opposite directions, fulfilling our doctrines
and preparing for our next Doctrinal War.
entries.source:
Human, days ago, I would have killed you for your insolence
but now... what is the use? You and your kind will receive the ultimate punishment soon enough.
I will tell you what you wish to know.
While the Kohr-Ah move through space, killing your neighboring species
we shall remain here, guarding the trophy... the Sa-Matra.
When the Kohr-Ah are done with their dark business
they will take possession of the Sa-Matra, and then we will part ways
traversing the galaxy in opposite directions, fulfilling our doctrines
and preparing for our next Doctrinal War.
entries.translation:
人類，幾天以前， 我會因你的傲慢殺了你
但現在……還有什麼用？ 你和同類很快就會受到終極 懲罰。
我會告訴你想知道的事。
克爾阿在太空中穿行、 屠殺你們的鄰近物種時
我們會留在這裡守衛戰利 品……薩馬特拉。
等克爾阿完成黑暗的事業
他們就會接收薩馬特拉， 接著我們將分道揚鑣
朝相反方向穿越銀河， 履行各自的教義
並為下一場教義戰爭做準 備。

entries.label: bye_wars_over
entries.body: Well, it's been less than uplifting. Bye.
entries.source: Well, it's been less than uplifting. Bye.
entries.translation: 嗯，真是一點也不振奮人 心。再見。

entries.label: GOODBYE_WARS_OVER
entries.body: Farewell human. I hope your species survives.
entries.source: Farewell human. I hope your species survives.
entries.translation: 再會了，人類。 希望你的物種能夠存續。

entries.label: SEND_MESSAGE
entries.body:
Attention interloper - heed this recorded message!
This drone-vessel speaks with the voice and authority of the Ur-Quan.
You are trespassing within Ur-Quan space.
This world, Earth, may not be approached for any reason.
Nor will hostilities against our orbital platform be tolerated.
In addition, your ship does not respond to standard Hierarchy identification transmissions
and is therefore deemed to be... independent.
This is not permissible -- only subservience shall be tolerated.
This drone now leaves to inform the Ur-Quan of your transgressions.
You are commanded to remain here and await the arrival of the Ur-Quan.
Disobedience will be punished.

entries.translation:
闖入者注意——留心這段錄 製訊息！
這艘無人船以烏爾關的聲音 與權威發言。
你正侵入烏爾關空域。
無論任何理由， 都不得接近這個名為地球的 世界。
也不容許對我方軌道平台採 取敵對行動。
此外，你的船艦並未回應階 序的制式識別訊號
因此被視為……獨立個體。
這不受允許——我們只容許 臣服。
這艘無人船現在將離開， 向烏爾關通報你的罪行。
命令你留在這裡， 等待烏爾關抵達。
違抗命令必受懲罰。

entries.label: INIT_HELLO
entries.body:
WHAT! A human in a Precursor service vehicle?!
How did you escape the slave shield, human?
Or are you a rogue?
entries.source:
WHAT! A human in a Precursor service vehicle?!
How did you escape the slave shield, human?
Or are you a rogue?
entries.translation:
什麼！一個人類竟搭乘先驅 者勤務載具？！
人類，你怎麼逃出奴役護盾 的？
還是你是個叛徒？

entries.label: SUBSEQUENT_HELLO_1
entries.body: Human, you have ignored our commands and now you will be punished.
entries.source: Human, you have ignored our commands and now you will be punished.
entries.translation: 人類，你無視我們的命令， 現在必須受罰。

entries.label: SUBSEQUENT_HELLO_2
entries.body:
Your insubordination is intolerable!
You MUST obey our slave laws!
Further disobedience will result in punitive measures against your homeworld.
entries.source:
Your insubordination is intolerable!
You MUST obey our slave laws!
Further disobedience will result in punitive measures against your homeworld.
entries.translation:
你的抗命令人無法容忍！
你必須服從我們的奴隸法！
再度違抗，將導致你的母星 遭受懲罰措施。

entries.label: SUBSEQUENT_HELLO_3
entries.body: We will give you no more warnings, renegade human.
entries.source: We will give you no more warnings, renegade human.
entries.translation: 不會再有警告了， 人類叛徒。

entries.label: SUBSEQUENT_HELLO_4
entries.body: We will give you no more warnings, renegade human.
entries.source: We will give you no more warnings, renegade human.
entries.translation: 不會再有警告了， 人類叛徒。

entries.label: you_must_surrender
entries.body: Uh... surrender foul creature!
entries.source: Uh... surrender foul creature!
entries.translation: 呃……投降吧，邪惡生物！

entries.label: NOPE
entries.body: Submit or die foolish human!
entries.source: Submit or die foolish human!
entries.translation: 臣服，否則就死， 愚蠢的人類！

entries.label: i_surrender
entries.body: Okay. I guess I surrender.
entries.source: Okay. I guess I surrender.
entries.translation: 好吧。我想我投降。

entries.label: DISOBEDIENCE_PUNISHED
entries.body:
We will not kill your entire crew
only those responsible for decision making
specifically YOU, Captain, and your officers.
entries.source:
We will not kill your entire crew
only those responsible for decision making
specifically YOU, Captain, and your officers.
entries.translation:
我們不會殺死你的全體船員
只會殺死負責決策的人
具體來說，就是你，船長， 還有你的軍官。

entries.label: i_wont_surrender
entries.body: Nope! I won't surrender!
entries.source: Nope! I won't surrender!
entries.translation: 才不要！我不投降！

entries.label: BAD_CHOICE
entries.body:
You have made the incorrect choice
and now you must suffer the consequences of your mistake.
entries.source:
You have made the incorrect choice
and now you must suffer the consequences of your mistake.
entries.translation:
你作出了錯誤選擇
現在必須承受犯錯的後果。

entries.label: i_will_surrender
entries.body: I really, really, honestly surrender. I mean it. No kidding.
entries.source: I really, really, honestly surrender. I mean it. No kidding.
entries.translation: 我真的、真的、 很誠懇地投降。 我是認真的。沒開玩笑。

entries.label: GOOD_CHOICE
entries.body:
Your wise decision has spared many of your crew the pain of death.
However, as the commanding officer of your renegade vessel
you will bear the full extent of the defined punishment
which is death...
entries.source:
Your wise decision has spared many of your crew the pain of death.
However, as the commanding officer of your renegade vessel
you will bear the full extent of the defined punishment
which is death...
entries.translation:
明智的決定，讓你的許多船 員免於死亡之苦。
然而，身為這艘叛變船艦的 指揮官
你將承受既定刑罰的完整後 果
也就是死亡……

entries.label: key_phrase
entries.body: Hold! What you are doing to us is wrong! Why do you do this thing?
entries.source: Hold! What you are doing to us is wrong! Why do you do this thing?
entries.translation: 住手！你們這樣對待我們是 錯的！為什麼要做這種事？

entries.label: URQUAN_STORY
entries.body:
Alien, you have spoken the Words, and you have spoken them rightly.
We will tell you our reasons why we enslave all other sentient life.
We evolved on a hostile world, the descendants of solitary hunters.
In those ancient days, there was no Kohr-Ah or Kzer-Za, only the Ur-Quan.
We explored our world, and then the space beyond.
Here we met the six races of the Sentient Milieu, which we joined as partners.
It was on a routine planetfall that one of our Milieu scoutships first met the Dnyarri.
They were evilly intelligent creatures who could control the minds of others.
They wanted to rule the universe. We had no choice but to give it to them.
For thousands of years, we were unthinking slaves to the Dnyarri.
The Dnyarri had a special liking for us Ur-Quan
so they began to tinker with our genes. They built two Ur-Quan sub-races
one Green, the thinkers and planners
the other Black, the warriors and laborers.
When the martyred genius Kzer-Za gave us the secret to defeating the Dnyarri, we destroyed them.
Then we decided that we would never again be slaves.
We would follow the Path of Now and Forever.
We decided to enslave or imprison all other intelligent life in the galaxy.
We had slave-shielded one world, when we learned that the Black Ur-Quan
under a new leader, Kohr-Ah, had devised the Eternal Doctrine
which called for the `cleansing', the annihilation, of all non-Ur-Quan sentient life.
Before we could stop them, they burned the Yuptar race's homeworld
and were on their way to the planet of the last remaining free race.
We met the Kohr-Ah in orbit above that planet. We confronted them. They would not submit. We fought.
When our battle was done, the Kohr-Ah were defeated.
We exiled them, sent the remnant of the Kohr-Ah fleet into the unknown reaches of the galaxy.
Then we began our own migration, moving around the galaxy in the opposite direction of the Kohr-Ah.
Captain. You have heard our words. Now you have a decision to make.
Submit to us, the Ur-Quan Kzer-Za, or face our wrath.

entries.translation:
外星人，你說出了那些話， 而且說得正確。
我們會告訴你， 為何要奴役所有其他智慧生 命。
我們在一個充滿敵意的世界 演化，是獨居獵手的後裔。
遠古時代，沒有克爾阿或克 澤爾扎，只有烏爾關。
我們探索自己的世界， 接著探索外面的太空。
在那裡，我們遇見智慧共同 體的六個種族， 並以夥伴身分加入。
在一次例行行星登陸中， 共同體的一艘偵察艦首次遇 見迪納里。
他們是邪惡而聰明的生物， 能控制他者的心智。
他們想統治宇宙。 我們別無選擇， 只能把宇宙交給他們。
數千年間，我們都是迪納里 沒有思想的奴隸。
迪納里特別喜愛我們烏爾關
所以開始擺弄我們的基因。 他們創造了兩個烏爾關亞種
一個是綠色種， 負責思考與規劃
另一個是黑色種， 擔任戰士與勞工。
殉道天才克澤爾扎讓我們得 知擊敗迪納里的祕密後， 我們摧毀了他們。
接著，我們決定永遠不再為 奴。
我們將遵循永恆現世之道。
我們決定奴役或囚禁銀河中 所有其他智慧生命。
我們才剛用奴役護盾封鎖一 個世界，就得知黑色烏爾關
在新領袖克爾阿帶領下， 創立了永恆教義
要求進行`淨化'， 也就是滅絕所有非烏爾關智 慧生命。
我們還來不及阻止， 他們就焚毀了尤普塔爾種族 的母星
並朝僅存的最後一個自由種 族之行星前進。
我們在那顆行星上方的軌道 與克爾阿相遇。 我們與他們對峙。 他們拒絕臣服。於是開戰。
戰鬥結束時，克爾阿戰敗。
我們放逐他們， 把克爾阿殘餘艦隊送進銀河 未知的邊陲。
接著展開自己的遷徙， 朝與克爾阿相反的方向環繞 銀河。
船長。你已聽完我們的話。 現在必須作出決定。
向我們烏爾關克澤爾扎臣 服，否則就承受我們的怒 火。

entries.label: like_to_leave
entries.body: I will leave now.
entries.source: I will leave now.
entries.translation: 我現在要離開。

entries.label: INDEPENDENCE_IS_BAD
entries.body:
Your independence is too dangerous for us to tolerate.
You shall be punished.
entries.source:
Your independence is too dangerous for us to tolerate.
You shall be punished.
entries.translation:
你的獨立性太過危險， 我們無法容忍。
你將受到懲罰。

entries.label: whats_up_1
entries.body: Why do you wish to enslave us?
entries.source: Why do you wish to enslave us?
entries.translation: 你們為什麼想奴役我們？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_1
entries.body:
Although you consider us the enemy, these conclusions are flawed. We are your salvation.
We bring you peace
a peace built upon OUR social framework imposed upon your planet
a new world order in which your prosperity and security are assured by the Ur-Quan.
We will protect you from the hazards of this hostile universe, from dangers so hideous
your simple minds cannot imagine their dark scope.
Today, we are the enemy. In time, this will change.
Soon, you will come to understand the boon of slavery we force upon you
and then, you will revere and even love us for this gift.

entries.translation:
你們把我們視為敵人， 但這項結論並不正確。 我們是你們的救贖。
我們為你帶來和平
一種建立在我們社會架構之 上、強加於你們星球的和平
一套新的世界秩序， 由烏爾關保障你們的繁榮與 安全。
我們將保護你們免受這個敵 意宇宙的危害， 遠離那些恐怖到
你們簡單心智無法想像其黑 暗規模的危險。
今天，我們是敵人。 終有一天，這會改變。
很快，你就會理解我們強加 於你們的奴役有何恩惠
到時，你會因這份贈禮崇 敬、甚至愛戴我們。

entries.label: whats_up_2
entries.body: You didn't answer my question. What's your problem?
entries.source: You didn't answer my question. What's your problem?
entries.translation: 你沒有回答我的問題。 你到底有什麼毛病？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_2
entries.body:
You have intruded upon the battleground of our Doctrinal conflict with the Kohr-Ah.
This is not tolerable.
We must maintain our concentration on this war. We must win.
Should we lose, the consequences to you and all other sentient life in this part of the galaxy
would be very grave.
Since you have refused to depart willingly
it appears that we must eliminate you ourselves.

entries.translation:
你闖入了我們與克爾阿發生 教義衝突的戰場。
這無法容忍。
我們必須專注於這場戰爭。 我們必須勝利。
一旦戰敗，對你和銀河這片 區域的所有其他智慧生命而 言
後果都將極為嚴重。
既然你拒絕自願離開
看來我們只能親手消滅你。

entries.label: whats_up_3
entries.body: Hello? Ur-Quan? Are you paying attention to me?
entries.source: Hello? Ur-Quan? Are you paying attention to me?
entries.translation: 哈囉？烏爾關？ 你有在聽我說話嗎？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_3
entries.body:
In our twenty thousand years along the Path of Now and Forever
we have dominated thousands of species, yes
but we have saved hundreds from extinction.
You imagine the threat of unknown invaders, or alien pestilence borne on the solar wind.
We have seen these. But you do not acknowledge your own worst enemy, yourselves.
We have found dead worlds without number, planets ravaged by atomic fire or gaian collapse.
These planets were not rendered sterile by outside forces.
They bear sad testament to the effects of unrestrained instinct and emotion
or simple ignorance.
We will prevent such mistakes.

entries.translation:
沿著永恆現世之道前進的兩 萬年間
我們確實支配了數千個物種
但也拯救數百個物種免於滅 絕。
你們想像著未知侵略者的威 脅，或隨太陽風而來的外星 瘟疫。
這些我們都見過。 但你們拒絕承認自己最可怕 的敵人：你們自身。
我們見過無數死寂世界， 有些行星遭原子烈火蹂躪， 有些因生態圈崩潰而毀滅。
這些行星並非被外力化為不 毛之地。
它們悲哀地見證了毫無節制 的本能與情緒
或單純無知，會帶來什麼後 果。
我們會阻止這類錯誤。

entries.label: whats_up_4
entries.body: You aren't much of a listener, are you?
entries.source: You aren't much of a listener, are you?
entries.translation: 你不太會傾聽，對吧？

entries.label: GENERAL_INFO_4
entries.body:
A final command human, but it is more of a plea.
Your insubordination has guaranteed your death, there can be no alternative
but your species has not yet crossed the threshold of disobedience
that would require us to decimate Earth.
You have survived combat with us before. You may survive the ensuing battle.
If this happens, leave! Return to your home. Await our arrival there.
If you interfere with us here, we may lose the Doctrinal conflict with the Kohr-Ah.
If we are defeated, you are defeated as well.
The Kohr-Ah will be unleashed. They will begin a genocidal orgy, cleansing all known sentience.
They will crack the slave shield around Earth and reduce the surface of your blue world to cinders.

entries.translation:
人類，最後一道命令， 但它更像懇求。
你的抗命已注定自己必死， 別無選擇
但你的物種還沒跨過不服從 的門檻
尚未到需要我們重創地球的 地步。
你以前曾從與我們的戰鬥中 存活。接下來一戰， 你或許也能生還。
若真如此，就離開！ 返回家園。在那裡等待我們 抵達。
如果你在這裡干擾我們， 我們可能會輸掉與克爾阿的 教義衝突。
我們若戰敗，你們也同樣戰 敗。
克爾阿將再無拘束。 他們會展開種族滅絕的狂 歡，淨化一切已知智慧生 命。
他們會擊碎地球周圍的奴役 護盾，將你們藍色世界的地 表燒成灰燼。

entries.label: OUT_TAKES
entries.body:
Blah, blah, blah!
Mary had a little lamb!
I like to hold fuzzy little animals and give them huggie-wuggies.
You are probably wondering why an Ur-Quan is saying such stupid things.
Well, he isn't saying them. I am... that's right -- ME
the little guy down in the corner.
Since I've been stuck down here for this entire game
translating `Submit or Die!' into about a hundred different languages
I just thought I'd take this opportunity to express MY feelings.
You want to know what I think?
I think this whole game would have been better
if they'd done it as a musical!
That's what I think, but do the designers listen to me? NO!

entries.translation:
廢話，廢話，廢話！
瑪麗有隻小綿羊！
我喜歡抱著毛茸茸的小動 物，跟牠們抱抱又蹭蹭。
你大概在想，烏爾關為什麼 會說這種蠢話。
其實才不是他說的。是 我……沒錯——就是我
躲在角落底下的小傢伙。
我在這整場遊戲裡一直卡在 下面
把`投降否則死！ '翻譯成大約一百種不同語 言
所以只想趁這個機會表達我 的感受。
想知道我怎麼想嗎？
我認為這整款遊戲都會變得 更好
只要他們把它做成音樂劇！
這就是我的想法， 但設計師有聽我的嗎？ 才沒有！
